description: Header file defining functions for configuration management in prplMesh, including retrieving and setting parameters related to hostap interfaces, radio parameters, and configuration options.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_hostapd_ifaces
methods.description: Retrieves hostap interfaces from the database into a map.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_param
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from the database.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_radio_param
methods.description: Retrieves a radio-specific parameter value from the database.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_param_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value from the database.

methods.name: cfg_get_prplmesh_param_int_default
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value with a default fallback.

methods.name: cfg_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the channel number for a given interface.

methods.name: cfg_get_wep_key
methods.description: Retrieves WEP key for an interface (not implemented).

methods.name: cfg_set_prplmesh_config
methods.description: Sets and commits a configuration option.

methods.name: cfg_set_prplmesh_config_no_commit
methods.description: Sets a configuration option without committing.
